canonical_receiver_binding.receiver_leaf_requirement: Fresh leaf with serverAuth EKU and IP SAN 127.0.0.1, verified for sslserver against the exact staged fresh receiver CA.
canonical_receiver_binding.vehicle_leaf_requirement: Fresh non-CA leaf with clientAuth EKU whose Subject.CommonName maps to the sealed fresh synthetic VIN under pinned known-issuer parsing, verified for sslclient against the exact staged fresh vehicle CA.

required_pre_runtime_checks: Generate every CA, leaf, private key, bearer and spool key fresh inside the r7 root after proving it absent; do not reuse any closed-lane bytes.
Resolve the actual guest-host interface before issuing the Edge server leaf; require its exact IP SAN and bind that address to the reserved Hub-facing listener.
Verify issuer, CA constraints, critical key usage, EKU, validity, key correspondence and intended sslclient or sslserver purpose for every leaf.
Derive PEM and DER SHA-256 values from the exact staged public certificates and CA files. Do not expose private values or publish private-key hashes.
Require every private input to be a canonical owner-only single-link non-symlink file under an owner-only root.

Create the private actor binding before zero-event runtime review with event_authorized=false, the sealed identity, fixed transaction ID, canonical endpoint and canonical payload; hash it in the redacted receipt.
Keep authorization.json, contract.json, guard.json, result.json, .result.json.tmp and helper-output.log absent until a later explicit submit-once decision.

sealed_event_profile.binding_creation_stage: profile preparation before zero-event runtime review

future_redacted_certificate_profile_rece.reason_hash_is_null: The receipt and certificate bytes do not exist in this source-only preparation state; a hash must not be predicted or fabricated.
required_public_bindings: public certificate PEM and DER hashes
sealed identity hash without raw VIN
transaction ID, canonical endpoint and canonical payload hash
private actor binding path, mode and SHA-256
private-file path metadata without values or private-key hashes
source/staging receipt hashes and observer receipt hash

failure_policy: Any absent, unreadable, mismatched, expired, wrongly owned or wrongly addressed input closes r7 before runtime. No path substitution, certificate repair, identity carry-over or event authorization is permitted.
proof_boundary: This is a source-only certificate/profile preparation specification. It proves no certificate, key, credential, guest, listener, TLS session, zero baseline, event, forwarding, service, release, production, vehicle or user acceptance.
